title: The New Orleans revival: Nick's, Lu Watters and Jelly in New York
summary: Russell argues the so-called revival was not really one, covering New Orleans players at Nick's, Jelly's 1938-40 New York stay, Lu Watters in California, and whether Jazzmen helped.

bands.name: Jelly Roll Morton's Red Hot Peppers
